01

“Perhaps those who disbelieved will wish they had been Muslims”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 15:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Perhaps those who disbelieved will wish they had been Muslims [al-Hijr 2] he said: "That is the Day of Resurrection."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمَيْنِ [الحجر: 2] قَالَ: «ذَاكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
Edition record 372490 · p. 415Link to report ↗
02

“We do not send down the angels except with the truth”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 15:8).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
We do not send down the angels except with the truth [al-Hijr 8] meaning: "with the message and the punishment."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ [الحجر: 8] ، يَعْنِي: «بِالرِّسَالَةِ وَالْعَذَابِ»
Edition record 372491 · p. 415Link to report ↗

Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

those who have gone before [al-Hijr 24] "the earlier generations"; and those who come later [al-Hijr 24]: "the community of Muhammad."
العربية
الإسناد

الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ [الحجر: 24] «الْقُرُونُ الْأُولَى» ، الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ [الحجر: 24] : «أُمَّةُ مُحَمَّدٍ»

12

“Rather, we have come to you with that about which they were in doubt”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 15:63).

14
Explanation from Mujāhid 14

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid,
Rather, we have come to you with that about which they were in doubt [al-Hijr 63] he said: "They said to Lot: 'Rather, we have come to you with the punishment of your people.'" He said: "Lot had told them that punishment would descend upon them, and they had denied him."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونُ [الحجر: 63] قَالَ: " قَالُوا لِلُوطٍ: بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِعَذَابِ قَوْمِكَ "، قَالَ: «وَكَانَ لُوطٌ قَدْ أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّ الْعَذَابَ نَازِلٌ بِهِمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ»
Edition record 372503 · p. 417Link to report ↗
